items.title: Emeka Egbuka: 'Hopeful' for Week 1
items.description:
Egbuka (toe), per head coach Todd Bowles, will "hopefully" be ready for Week 1, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

items.title: Jeremiyah Love: Continues to progress
items.description:
Love (ankle) did not play in Friday's preseason loss to the Packers, but per Cardinals team reporter Zach Gershman he was able to work out prior to the game.

items.title: Xavier Worthy: One target in preseason debut
items.description:

items.title: Travis Kelce: One catch in preseason finale
items.description:

items.title: Makai Lemon: Three catches in preseason debut
items.description:
Lemon brought in three of five targets for five yards and returned one punt for no gain in the Eagles' 30-13 preseason loss to the Bengals on Friday. He also fumbled once but recovered.
